posts.description: It’s not the tools that don’t cut it anymore. It is the paradigm itself. The paradigm shifted without intent, it’s currently forming, but nailing it ahead of time is a tremendous advantage.
If Cloudflare is NSA/CIA effectively surveilling everyone’s traffic online in plain sight, then Bending Spoons is EU making cash payments to US in plain sight.
We need to change how software engineering works. Stop delivering code. Deliver thinking.
